eng.topic: CI, reviews and the Atlas launch
eng.purpose: Where the engineering team talks shop

messages.author: bob
messages.text: Windows CI went red again. The BFS path test only fails there, about one run in four.

messages.author: alice
messages.text: That smells like hash-map iteration order. `HashMap` walks its buckets differently every run.

messages.author: bob
messages.text: Filed it: http://github.com/northstar/atlas/issues/14

messages.author: carol
messages.text: Thanks. Tagging it P2 until we know it is only the test.

messages.author: alice
messages.text: Priya's answer on Stack Overflow nails it: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/t-4411

messages.author: alice
messages.text: Sort the neighbours before you walk them and the path is deterministic. :white_check_mark:

messages.author: bob
messages.text: Wrote it up while it was fresh: http://bmartinez.net/posts/hash-order-bit-me

messages.author: bob
messages.text: tl;dr never assert on iteration order, even in a test that only runs on Linux.

messages.author: carol
messages.text: Launch checklist: http://docs.google.com/documents/atlas-launch - @alice owns the confirmation.

messages.author: carol
messages.text: Tracked as OPS-1: http://linear.app/projects/OPS/issues/1

messages.author: alice
messages.text: On it. Confirmation email copy goes to legal today.

messages.author: alice
messages.text: Fix is up: http://github.com/northstar/atlas/pull/15 - `sort_unstable` on the adjacency list.

messages.author: bob
messages.text: Reviewing now. If the Windows job goes green three times in a row I will stop refreshing.

messages.author: admin
messages.text: Heads up: the CI runners get their kernel patch tonight at 22:00, expect 15 min of queued jobs.

messages.author: bob
messages.text: @admin can that wait until after the release candidate is cut tomorrow morning?

messages.author: admin
messages.text: Yes, moving it to Friday 22:00. :+1:

messages.author: alice
messages.text: Closing the loop: http://github.com/northstar/atlas/pull/15 makes the walk order stable.

messages.author: bob
messages.text: which monitor did you get?

messages.author: alice
messages.text: this one: http://amazon.com/dp/b0monitor27 - 27 inch, 4K, one USB-C cable for everything.

messages.author: bob
messages.text: Sold. Ordering one before carol notices the budget.

messages.author: carol
messages.text: :eyes: I notice everything.

messages.author: carol
messages.text: Launch week soundtrack: http://open.spotify.com/playlist/ship-it :fire:

messages.author: carol
messages.text: And the walkthrough, if you have not watched it: http://youtube.com/watch?v=atlas-walkthrough

messages.author: bob
messages.text: coffee machine on 3 is fixed :pray:

incidents.title: incidents
incidents.purpose: One thread per incident; admin runs the postmortem

messages.author: admin
messages.text: INC-4: elevated API latency. Status page is updated: http://status.northstar.example/

messages.author: admin
messages.text: Recovered after 12 minutes. Cause was a cold cache on the new pop.

messages.author: alice
messages.text: Nice catch. Do we pre-warm on deploy now?

messages.author: admin
messages.text: We do from tomorrow. It is in the postmortem.

messages.author: carol
messages.text: Postmortem is OPS-7: http://linear.app/projects/OPS/issues/7 - @admin owns it.

messages.author: admin
messages.text: Apology posted from @NorthstarHQ: http://x.com/NorthstarHQ

messages.author: carol
messages.text: New starters: the intranet has everything - http://intranet.internal/

messages.author: admin
messages.text: And the public guide for anything you would send outside: http://guide.example/

messages.author: carol
messages.text: Atlas launches Thursday the 24th. Dress rehearsal Monday, release candidate Wednesday. :rocket:

messages.author: admin
messages.text: Office wifi will drop for a minute around 12:30 today while the new AP goes in.

atlas-release.title: atlas-release
atlas-release.purpose: The people cutting and checking the Atlas release candidate

messages.author: carol
messages.text: RC plan: @bob cuts the candidate Wednesday morning, @alice runs the clean-machine install.

messages.author: bob
messages.text: Ack. Tag will be `v1.0.0-rc1`.

messages.author: alice
messages.text: Ack too. I will use the Windows laptop for the install run.

messages.author: bob
messages.text: did carol see the flaky test before the launch review?

messages.author: alice
messages.text: She did. It is on the board as OPS-2 and it is not blocking the launch.

messages.author: bob
messages.text: your PR looks good, one nit about the comment on the sort

messages.author: alice
messages.text: fixed, pushed :tada:

messages.author: carol
messages.text: Standup at 9:30 today instead of 9, I have the dentist first.

messages.author: alice
messages.text: ok! :pray: good luck
